def hunk_header(group):
    """Build the @@ -a,b +c,d @@ header for a group of opcodes."""
    first, last = group[0], group[-1]
    a_start, a_end = first[1], last[2]
    b_start, b_end = first[3], last[4]
    a_len = a_end - a_start
    b_len = b_end - b_start
    a_pos = a_start + 1 if a_len else a_start
    b_pos = b_start + 1 if b_len else b_start
    return "@@ -{},{} +{},{} @@".format(a_pos, a_len, b_pos, b_len)

def hunk_header(group):
    """Build the @@ -a,b +c,d @@ header for a group of opcodes."""
    first, last = group[0], group[-1]
    a_start, a_end = first[1], last[2]
    b_start, b_end = first[3], last[4]
    a_len = a_end - a_start
    b_len = b_end - b_start
    a_pos = a_start + 1 if a_len else a_start
    b_pos = b_start + 1 if b_len else b_start
